problems.stem: Compare both plants: which one is healthy?

problems.question: Compare both plants: which one is healthy?
problems.rationale: Plant A is green and standing tall because it gets sunlight and water. Plant B is brown and drooping because plants cannot stay healthy without sun and water.
problems.teachingNote: Prompt students to observe leaf color and posture as clues to plant health before connecting them to sun and water needs.
successCriteria: Compare two plants to identify which one is healthy.
Connect healthy plant growth to sunlight and water.
problems.subject: SCIENCE

problems.rationale: Plants require specific life elements like sunlight and water to grow big and strong. Non-living objects like rocks and toys do not help plants grow at all.
problems.teachingNote: Ensure students understand that physical objects found near plants do not automatically mean plants need them.
successCriteria: Sort items into needs and non-needs
problems.subject: SCIENCE

problems.question: Without any water?
problems.rationale: Plants must have water to stand tall and stay alive. Without water, a plant wilts and dries up.
problems.teachingNote: Demonstrate this concept visually by comparing a freshly watered plant to a dry, drooping leaf.
successCriteria: Analyze the effect of missing water on a plant.
problems.subject: SCIENCE
